review_scope: Pre-freeze design/source review; read-only inspection and existing-test evidence, no new simulation.
checks_passed: Known transfer/startup/pipeline timing and integer projection match actual physics.
Source timestamps, common source-indexed noise and same-source effective resource normalization match actual adapter.
Controller receives measured observations and exact resource commands; no future truth arrays or terminal schedule.
Hold and candidate costs pay transit/startup through lost service; no duplicated arbitrary transition penalty.
Dropped work remains in demand deficit; retained queue plus pipeline governs physical clearance.
Bootstrap pairing, static-relative risk definition, acceptance signs and fixed margins match declaration.
Validation rejects configuration overrides and binds the selected configuration through freeze and worker inputs.
Current peak-service-queue prose correctly defines maximum-over-time SUM of service queues, excluding pipeline.

prose_issues_reported_to_root.prior_description: Three consecutive empty observed end queues.
prose_issues_reported_to_root.actual_behavior: Three consecutive samples with total measured end queue <=10 work units.
prose_issues_reported_to_root.resolution: Root to clarify prose only; do not change controller.

prose_issues_reported_to_root.actual_behavior: Total measured queue must exceed10 and may decline by up to max(10 work units,2% of the previous measured queue) while extending the streak.
prose_issues_reported_to_root.resolution: Root to clarify near-flat/slightly-declining tolerance in prose only.

prose_issues_reported_to_root.prior_description: The busy anchor expires after eight minutes, with uncertainty widening.
prose_issues_reported_to_root.actual_behavior: Removing an old low anchor can narrow the interval; recent-evidence count and sensor lag separately widen the point-relative band.
prose_issues_reported_to_root.resolution: Root to distinguish anchor removal from sparse/lagged uncertainty widening in prose only.
